mapper.select:
select ol.*, u.name as operate_user_name from operate_log ol left join user u on ol.operate_user_id = u.id
and u.name like concat('%', #{operateUserName}, '%')
order by ol.operate_time desc
mapper.insert:
insert into operate_log (operate_user_id, operate_time, class_name, method_name, method_params, return_value, cost_time) values
(#{item.operateUserId}, #{item.operateTime}, #{item.className}, #{item.methodName}, #{item.methodParams}, #{item.returnValue}, #{item.costTime})
